Overview

The ASUS Vivobook 15 empowers you to work and enjoy entertainment wherever you are, thanks to a lightweight, compact design. It features reliable multitasking, thoughtful security, and display enhancements for comfort during long sessions. Designed for convenient daily use, it fits easily into your busy schedule.
  • Intel Core 5 320 processor with 16GB RAM and a fast 512GB SSD lets you multitask smoothly
  • 15.6” Full HD display with 84% screen-to-body ratio offers vivid visuals and more workspace

What you need to know

  • Windows 11 Home operating system for easy everyday use
  • Intel Core 5 320 processor, 16GB DDR5 RAM, and 512GB SSD for reliable multitasking and fast storage
  • 15.6" Full HD screen, 1920 x 1080 native resolution, and LED panel for sharp views
  • Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) and Bluetooth 5.3 wireless card for fast, modern connectivity
  • Copilot+ PC for enhanced system intelligence

Performance & Storage

  • Intel Core 5 320 processor delivers robust performance for smooth multitasking
  • 16GB DDR5 RAM and 512GB SSD enable seamless app switching and quick file access

Graphics

  • Intel Graphics integrated GPU provides dependable everyday visuals

Display

  • 15.6" Full HD (1920 x 1080) screen with 16:9 aspect ratio offers immersive viewing
  • 84% screen-to-body ratio for an expansive experience
  • TÜV Rheinland certification with low-blue light helps care for your eyes during long use
  • Anti-glare LED display reduces reflections for more comfortable viewing

Battery & Power

  • Three-cell lithium ion battery delivers portable use
  • 3,550mAh battery capacity helps you stay productive on the move

Keyboard & Trackpad

  • ASUS ErgoSense chiclet keyboard with bilingual layout and backlit keys for comfortable typing
  • Optimized key travel and tactile response for better productivity
  • Larger multi-finger touchpad supports efficient navigation

Ports & Connectivity

  • Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) (dual band) 1x1 and Bluetooth 5.3 wireless card keep you connected
  • USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C, two USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A, USB 2.0 Type-A, HDMI 1.4, and combo audio jack support a full range of peripherals (USB transfer speed may vary)

Webcam

  • HD camera with built-in privacy shutter allows you to slide the lens cover for added security and peace of mind

Stay Secure

  • Fingerprint sensor supports fast, secure login with Windows Hello

Included Software

  • Copilot+ PC provides enhanced system features

Lightweight

  • 1.70kg and 1.79cm thin design for convenient, lightweight portability

Additional Features

  • 180-degree lay-flat hinge offers flexible positioning for collaborative work
  • Military-grade durability (meets MIL-STD 810H) stands up to tough conditions
  • ASUS AI noise cancellation uses machine learning to reduce unwanted sounds for clear communication
